items.title: Kukkarahalli Lake visitors risk crocodile attack
items.snippet_en: Star of Mysore reported on September 7, 2026, that Kukkarahalli Lake is an established habitat for mugger crocodiles, noting visitor safety concerns and warning signs around the lake, but mentions no sighting on October 15, 2026.

items.title: A crocodile spotted at Kukkarahalli Lake in the city
items.snippet_en: On January 28, 2026, Star of Mysore reported a single crocodile spotted on the lake bund near Rangayana at Kukkarahalli Lake, noting that crocodile sightings at the lake are infrequent.

items.title: Crocodile sighted in Kukkarahalli Lake
items.snippet_en: On December 1, 2024, Star of Mysore reported a mugger crocodile sighting near the fishermen's shed close to Hunsur Main Road at Kukkarahalli Lake.

items.title: Giant crocodile appears near Mysore lake
items.snippet_en: The Hindu reported on March 26, 2010, that an adult marsh crocodile was spotted on the Kukkarahalli Lake bund near the Manasagangotri campus before returning to the water.

outputs.notes_en: Sources confirm that Kukkarahalli Lake is a known crocodile habitat with occasional documented sightings in the past, but there is no reporting or official confirmation of two crocodiles being spotted on October 15, 2026.
